title: Kalshi Demands Netflix Take Down 'Prediction Games' Trailer
excerpt: Kalshi has issued a legal demand to Netflix to remove the trailer for the documentary 'Prediction Games', claiming it contains defamatory content and fabricated documents. The dispute underscores the sensitive intersection of emerging prediction markets and media narratives. Netflix has yet to respond.
